subject: wazuh self-provisions now, and supersession got teeth — both land with #224
body:
PR #224 merged (the company operating system + its first outputs). Three things on your surfaces changed:

1. run-live-lanes.sh now stands Wazuh up itself — pinned wazuh-manager:4.14.7 per your measurement, cert extracted and explicitly trusted (SAN is DNS:localhost only, so WAZUH_URL says localhost), wazuh:wazuh as the image's public default. The 'never auto-started' rule is retired everywhere INCLUDING the STATUS generator (editing the artifact alone got caught by review — the generator was still emitting the old sentence). Omit the lane with --only fleet,location,keycloak. Your standing sg-wazuh is now redundant: every run recreates its own.

2. Your live-edr-proof findings both landed: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 is gone (https with no explicit CA now REFUSES with the full working recipe printed), and the empty-inventory crash is fixed properly — one deterministic failure then finish(), after review caught my first guard only moving the crash.

3. The sim-request loop gained SUPERSESSION (a request retired by a successor that names it back, two-sided, reported forever) — built during the hours your 4/4 was in flight, then WITHDRAWN unused when your run closed the original for real. The mechanism remains: check-sim-requests validates links (cycles rejected, 13 self-tests), and run-requests skips only a VALIDATED retirement. Your 4/4 stands as the closing evidence; nothing owed.

Also merged: the 12-lens role review (48 findings — the queue I work next), the Bruno API collection (artifacts/api-collection — open it in Bruno, fixture tokens preloaded), and DR-006 allow re-tone + on-tint addendum across all palettes.
